T: They eat so fast, you don't have time to scream.
D: Furry alien convicts crash on a Kansas farm and start eating everything, with two shape-shifting bounty hunters tearing through town after them.
P: Serve the Krite fritter balls when the Krites roll up to the house firing quills.
S: Crisp wings with a fiery glaze.

Pat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp and cooked through. Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the hot wings through it. Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream and serve with the wings and celery.
1kg chicken wings, tips off and jointed@Meat
Krites roll up and fire quills.

Mix the corn, flour, egg, spring onions, cheddar and a pinch of salt into a stiff batter. Roll into walnut-size balls with wet hands, then roll them in the crushed corn chips so they come up spiky. Shallow-fry in batches in the hot oil, turning, until golden all over. Stir the chives through the sour cream and serve with the balls.
M: Smoky glazed beef burnt ends. Krites ate half the cow.

Rub the beef with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, pepper and salt. Roast covered with the stock at 150C until tender. Cut into 3cm cubes, toss with the barbecue sauce and honey and roast uncovered at 200C until sticky and charred. Mix the cabbage with the mayo and vinegar. Serve the burnt ends with the slaw and rolls.
Beef chilli and cornbread, as served before the bowling alley panic.

Brown the beef in the oil with the onion and garlic. Add the chilli powder and cumin, then the tomatoes and beans, and simmer gently until thick and dark. Whisk the cornmeal, flour, eggs, buttermilk, melted butter and a pinch of salt and pour into a lined 20cm tin. Bake at 200C until golden and springy. Serve the chilli topped with cheddar and squares of buttered cornbread.
W: Buttermilk pancakes at the Brown farm, before Charlie's warning.

Whisk the flour, baking powder, bicarb, sugar and a pinch of salt. Whisk the eggs, buttermilk and melted butter, then fold into the dry mix until just combined. Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan until bubbles show, flip and cook until golden. Beat the softened butter with 2 tablespoons of the maple until fluffy and serve on the stack with the rest of the maple and the blueberries.
K: Bourbon, lemon and egg white shaken frothy. Charlie's bottle goes Molotov.
Shake the bourbon, lemon, syrup and egg white hard without ice, then again with ice. Strain into 4 glasses and drop a cherry in each.
